mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate below 0.15% compresses the risk-free rate, reducing equity discount rates and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors seek yield in equities.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS remains below 0.15%, or Rank IC falls below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate above 0.25% within one month signals imminent monetary tightening, causing immediate equity sell-offs as higher discount rates reduce equity valuations and corporate borrowing capacity.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS rises above 0.25% within 1 month, or Rank IC remains negative over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in unemployment rate and increases in nonfarm payrolls signal a tightening labor market that boosts corporate profit margins through productivity gains and wage growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE falls and PAYEMS rises, or interaction effect p-value exceeds 0.05 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions characterized by rising housing starts and retail sales, strong consumer demand drives corporate revenue growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days, but this effect vanishes in early-cycle regimes.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where HOUST and RSAFS both exceed 1-year moving averages, or regime-specific Rank IC < 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production above its 12-month moving average indicates expanding manufacturing capacity and improved supply chain efficiency, reducing input costs and boosting equity valuations for positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where INDPRO exceeds 12-month moving average, or Rank IC < 0.05 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in unemployment rate below 5.0% within one month signals labor market overheating that triggers aggressive Fed rate hikes, causing immediate equity volatility and negative S&P 500 returns over 5 days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE falls below 5.0% within 1 month, or Rank IC remains negative over 3-year periods.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in retail sales and housing starts indicate robust consumer and residential demand, driving higher corporate revenues and positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days, with effect strength proportional to demand momentum.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where RSAFS and HOUST both rise, or interaction effect p-value > 0.05 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: During high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.0% annually), a decline in the federal funds rate signals aggressive monetary easing to stabilize prices, producing positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days as markets anticipate economic stabilization.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 3.0% annually and FEDFUNDS declines, or interaction effect p-value > 0.05 over 3-year windows.
